name: navora-monitor
author: Navora
description: Navora Monitor — LAN CCTV preview, recording, and playback (FFmpeg)

scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && vite build && node scripts/build-electron.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/pack.mjs win-x64
scripts.dist:win-arm: npm run build && node scripts/pack.mjs win-arm64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/pack.mjs linux-x64
scripts.dist:linux-arm: npm run build && node scripts/pack.mjs linux-arm64
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && node scripts/pack.mjs win-x64 portable
scripts.dist:nsis: npm run build && node scripts/pack.mjs win-x64 nsis
